sources_considered.why: Readable telemetry study distinguishes allocation and active computation, but does not measure warehoused NVIDIA shipments.
Primary disclosure of realized cloud revenue during the selected quarter; broader than GPU-attributable revenue.
Readable individual-company results cannot establish the proportion of all purchasing companies or all NVIDIA shipments.
Search result concerns a later survey of GPU operators and idle time, rather than the target-quarter warehouse denominator.

evidence_items.explanation: The study covers operating accelerator telemetry through June 2026. Its installed-fleet sample and GPU-hour denominator cannot establish the share of sold NVIDIA hardware in warehouses or the share of buyers earning substantial revenue.

Microsoft reports substantial realized cloud revenue, but this includes services beyond purchased GPUs. Neither that revenue nor the separate future performance obligations settle the buyer-wide claim.

unresolved_gaps: No representative count of GPU purchasers and their GPU-attributable revenue.
No shipment-linked census of stored versus operational NVIDIA GPUs.
No specified sales cohort, weighting rule or accounting basis.
The utilization study does not provide a representative sample of hardware that never reached an operating cluster.
